text: Over the two days since the last run, electronics (about +2,170 reviews) and beauty (about +1,930) moved most on Amazon, led by big brands such as OnePlus and by Ghar Soaps, while clay diyas and Diwali lights rank high just before Diwali on 8 November. For a beginner, small home items, crossbody bags and light fitness accessories look most approachable, while earbuds, personal care and beauty are led by big brands.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, silk-look sarees crowd the list
text: Kurta sets from Klosia and Indo Era have the most reviews, and a ₹799 Klosia Anarkali set gained the most in two days (+95). Kanjivaram and Banarasi-style sarees from C J Enterprise and Yashika are new to the list or ranking high, some with only a few hundred reviews, likely festive and wedding buying. The typical price is about ₹699, more than double Meesho's ₹291. Among the top 10 products, about 10.7% of reviews are 1-star, so quality complaints are a real risk. Kurtas have sizes, which usually means returns, so free-size sarees are the easier way in.

headline: Women's western: Amazon's Symbol leads, smaller labels can rank
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have the most reviews, and tops and shirts carry about two-thirds of the category's reviews. RIEKA embroidered tops rank high with only a few hundred reviews, which suggests newer listings can rank here. Growth is small, with about 200 new reviews in two days, and a ₹599 Shasmi maxi dress gained the most (+24). The typical price is about ₹489, above Meesho's ₹281. Among the top 10 products, about 10.3% of reviews are 1-star, and sizes are the main risk, so start with a small range.

headline: Men's clothing: known brands in shirts, jackets for winter
text: Allen Solly, Van Heusen and Amazon's Symbol lead on reviews, and an Allen Solly polo gained the most in two days (+37). Lymio jackets and Boldfit hoodies rank high on the winter list, which fits the colder weather ahead. The typical price is about ₹599, compared with Meesho's ₹333. Among the top 10 products, about 8.9% of reviews are 1-star. Winter demand looks real, but big brands and sizing make this a hard place to start.

headline: Kids & toys: toys carry the demand, clothing sets are new
text: Toys hold nearly all the reviews here, led by a ₹99 Uno card game and soft toys around ₹170 to ₹180. In the last two days a kick scooter (+52) and a ₹199 LCD writing pad (+41) gained the most. Top kids' clothing sets have very few reviews so far, so that list looks new and unsettled. The typical price is about ₹569, compared with Meesho's ₹182, and among the top 10 products about 8.2% of reviews are 1-star. Small toys have no sizes and are easier to ship, though toys sold in India have safety rules you should read about before stocking.

headline: Home & kitchen: useful gadgets, plus last-minute Diwali buying
text: A Pigeon mini chopper and Milton bottles have the most reviews, while an Aliston kitchen scale (+110) and a ₹319 electric gas lighter (+74) gained the most in two days. Clay diyas at ₹40 to ₹51 rank in the top 6 of Home & Décor with very few reviews, and fairy lights are moving, which is likely Diwali buying, so it's too late to start those now. The typical price is about ₹244, compared with Meesho's ₹163. Among the top 10 products, about 11.9% of reviews are 1-star, the highest here, so check quality carefully. Small, light, useful items suit beginners, but well-known kitchen brands lead.

headline: Beauty: Ghar Soaps and face washes are moving, brands lead
text: Dettol, Vaseline, Cetaphil and Parachute lead on reviews, and Ghar Soaps bath bars gained the most in two days (+251), followed by Cetaphil (+146) and Simple (+104) face washes. The typical price is about ₹222, close to Meesho's ₹189. Only about 4.8% of reviews on the top 10 products are 1-star, among the lowest here. Reselling brands needs authorisation and making your own cosmetics needs a licence, so this stays hard for a beginner. This category had 39 products today, because many Skin Care items also appear on the Beauty list.

headline: Jewellery: gold pendants rank high, fashion sets are the real option
text: Gold pendants and coins costing ₹15,000 or more rank near the top with few reviews, likely festive buying that won't last and isn't suited to a beginner. Shining Diva and YouBella fashion jewellery has the most reviews, and new bangle sets and necklace combos are appearing at about ₹280, the category's typical price, compared with Meesho's ₹166, and growth is very small at about 50 new reviews in two days. Among the top 10 products, about 9.9% of reviews are 1-star. These items are light with no sizes, and wedding season is ahead. This category had 30 products today, because the two Amazon lists almost fully overlapped.

headline: Bags & footwear: comfort slippers lead, crossbody bags can rank
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers have the most reviews, and comfort slippers took all of the top growth spots in two days, led by Frido (+53). Among bags, Lavie has the most reviews, but crossbody bags from Walizza and Lyrovo rank in the top 2 with about 650 to 1,150 reviews. The typical price is about ₹568, nearly three times Meesho's ₹204. Among the top 10 products, about 8.5% of reviews are 1-star. Bags have no sizes and suit a beginner better than footwear, which usually means more returns.

headline: Electronics: earphones and chargers from big brands
text: OnePlus, boAt and realme dominate with very high review counts, and this category gained the most new reviews in two days (about 2,170), led by OnePlus neckbands (+180) and earbuds (+141). Samsung and Apple chargers and Portronics cables also rank in the top 10. The typical price is about ₹699, compared with Meesho's ₹325. Among the top 10 products, about 10.1% of reviews are 1-star. Competing with these brands in earbuds or chargers is hard, so only simple unbranded accessories like holders and phone covers are worth checking.

headline: Health & fitness: brands lead care, fitness gear is open
text: Dettol handwash, Havells dryers and Philips trimmers lead Personal Care, which a beginner can't easily compete with, and a Philips trimmer gained the most in two days (+98). In Exercise & Fitness, pull-up bars and dumbbells rank at the top, with a ₹161 hand gripper (+56) and ₹170 resistance bands selling too. The Amazon fitness list also shows hoodies and track pants, likely winter buying. The typical price is about ₹340, compared with Meesho's ₹237, and the 1-star share on the top 10 products is the lowest here at about 4.6%. Small, light fitness accessories suit a beginner far better than heavy equipment.

Small kitchen gadgets such as gas lighters and scales, once you've checked quality.
Light fitness accessories such as hand grippers and resistance bands, about ₹160 to ₹170.
Crossbody and sling bags, which have no sizes and can rank with few reviews.
Fashion bangle and necklace sets, ahead of wedding season.
Small toys such as LCD writing pads and soft toys, after reading the toy safety rules.

Avoid for now: earbuds and chargers (big brands), gold jewellery, branded beauty and personal care (authorisation), sized clothing (returns), and Diwali-only stock such as diyas and lights (too late to start).
